stormcaller.sentence: On each Gust beat, after the Stormcaller's turn, each unit is Pushed 1 tile downwind.

slagmaster.sentence: On each Wildfire beat, after every second Slagmaster turn, each Fire tile spreads 1 tile in the direction from the Slagmaster to you.

oracle.sentence: On each Frostbite beat, after every second Oracle turn, each unit on Ice takes 2 damage.

dynamo.sentence: On each Lightning Storm beat, when the Dynamo uses Arc Lash, each unit on Electrified takes 4 damage.

thornmother.sentence: On each Upheaval beat, after every second Thornmother turn, each Marked tile becomes an Outcrop.

prior.sentence: On each Shadowstep beat, after every second Prior turn, each hidden follower Blinks up to 3 tiles toward you.

snare_earth.sentence: On each Upheaval beat, after your turn, a Marked tile on the way out becomes an Outcrop.

snare_fire.sentence: On each Wildfire beat, after your turn, each Fire tile spreads 1 tile away from the entry.

snare_air.sentence: On each Gust beat, after your turn, each unit is Pushed 1 tile toward the entry.

snare_ice.sentence: On each Frostbite beat, after your turn, each unit on Ice takes 1 damage.

snare_lightning.sentence: On each Lightning Storm beat, after your turn, each unit on Electrified takes 3 damage.

snare_shadow.sentence: On each Shadowstep beat, after your turn, each hidden enemy Blinks up to 2 tiles toward you.

last_light.sentence: On each Shadowstep beat, after your turn, each hidden enemy Blinks up to 2 tiles toward you.

gale_herald.sentence: On each Gust beat, after the Gale Herald's turn, each unit is Pushed 1 tile downwind.

ashen_reaver.sentence: On each Wildfire beat, after every second turn of yours, each Fire tile spreads 1 tile in the direction from the Reaver to you.

rimejaw.sentence: On each Frostbite beat, after your turn, each unit on Ice takes Stagger 6.

storm_cantor.sentence: On each Lightning Storm beat, when the Cantor uses Peal, each unit on Electrified takes 4 damage.

gallows_roc.sentence: On each Gust beat, after your turn, each unit is Pushed 1 tile in the direction from you to the Roc.

craghide.sentence: On each Upheaval beat, after every second Craghide turn, each Marked tile becomes an Outcrop.

last_lamplighter.sentence: On each Shadowstep beat, after your turn, each hidden Wick Shade Blinks 1 tile toward you.

vyraketh.sentence: On each Wildfire beat, when Vyraketh breathes, each Fire tile spreads to each adjacent tile.

at_half_health.sentence: On each Wildfire beat, after every second Vyraketh turn, each Fire tile spreads to each adjacent tile.

tharokh.sentence: On each Upheaval beat, after every second turn of yours, each Marked tile becomes an Outcrop.

at_half_health.sentence: On each Upheaval beat, after your turn, each Marked tile becomes an Outcrop.

iskaldra.sentence: On each Frostbite beat, when Iskaldra uses Rime Talon, each unit on Ice takes 3 damage.

at_half_health.sentence: On each Frostbite beat, after every second Iskaldra turn, each unit on Ice takes 3 damage.

vaeloryx.sentence: On each Gust beat, after Vaeloryx's turn, each unit is Pushed 1 tile downwind, then Gust turns a quarter clockwise.

at_half_health.sentence: On each Gust beat, after Vaeloryx's turn, each unit is Pushed 2 tiles downwind, then Gust turns a quarter clockwise.

zekarion.sentence: On each Lightning Storm beat, when Zekarion uses Overload, each unit on Electrified takes 6 damage.

at_half_health.sentence: On each Lightning Storm beat, when Zekarion uses Overload, each unit on Electrified takes 7 damage.

noctyrax.sentence: On each Shadowstep beat, when Noctyrax uses Void Claw, each hidden Veilbound Acolyte Blinks up to 3 tiles toward you.
